comparisons.name: notes-light
comparisons.description: Note list of Notes, Aqua: five two-line rows, the first selected in grey (the list does not have focus), inset separators. Whole crop: the text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms, the thumbnails are stand-ins, and the screenshot's paper noise texture is painted as its mean colour.

comparisons.name: notes-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The same crop with the text lines and the two thumbnails (stand-in artwork) masked: scores the row height, the selection, the separators and their inset over the mean colour of the paper texture.

comparisons.name: notes-dark
comparisons.description: Note list of Notes, Dark Aqua: whole crop, with text in the fallback font and stand-in thumbnails.

comparisons.name: notes-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: The same crop with the text lines and the two thumbnails (stand-in artwork) masked, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: contacts-light

comparisons.name: contacts-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The same crop with the names masked, including the third name and its glyph, which only the screenshot has: scores the row height, the grey selection across the whole pane and the background.

comparisons.name: contacts-dark
comparisons.description: Name list of Contacts, Dark Aqua: whole crop, names in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: reminders-light

comparisons.name: forced-colors-text-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, after a click on the first row of a list whose text is full blocks and whose emphasised text colours are a marker (red): the title, the lead and the detail of the focused selection are the system's highlight text, not the marker. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

lead of its detail line: HighlightText, not the marker
its detail text: HighlightText, not the marker

comparisons.name: forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, after a click on the first name: the focused selection is the system's highlight colour, not the accent, and the row that was selected is the canvas again. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

comparisons.name: emphasized-light
comparisons.description: A click on the first name selects it and gives the list focus: the selection is the accent colour across the whole row, and the row that was selected is plain again. Aqua. No Contacts screenshot shows a focused list; the colour is the emphasised selection the spec measures elsewhere.
